# Crea8Hub

> Crea8Hub is a digital marketing and branding agency in Lagos, Nigeria. It provides brand strategy, social media management, content and video production, performance advertising (Meta, TikTok, Google, LinkedIn) and influencer marketing for Nigerian businesses, including fintech and financial services brands.

Contact: info@crea8hub.com · +234 806 059 9741 · Lagos, Nigeria

## Services
- [Branding agency in Lagos](https://www.crea8hub.com/branding-agency-lagos/): brand strategy, identity and brand communications
- [Social media marketing agency in Lagos](https://www.crea8hub.com/social-media-marketing-agency-lagos/): social media management and content strategy
- [Video production company in Lagos](https://www.crea8hub.com/video-production-company-lagos/): content production and creative campaigns
- [Digital advertising agency in Lagos](https://www.crea8hub.com/digital-advertising-agency-lagos/): Google, Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn ads
- [Influencer marketing agency in Nigeria](https://www.crea8hub.com/influencer-marketing-agency-nigeria/): creator and influencer campaigns
- [Fintech marketing agency in Nigeria](https://www.crea8hub.com/fintech-marketing-agency-nigeria/): marketing for fintech and financial services
